name: Gradflex experimental conditions and measurement summary

measured_variables.name: Environment
measured_variables.definition: Microgravity significantly enhanced fluctuation amplitude and altered spatial temporal dependence Ground-based results served as a crucial one g control
measured_variables.reported: Microgravity Foton M3 flight Terrestrial Ground-based

measured_variables.name: Fluid Sample
measured_variables.definition: Both fluid types exhibited enhanced fluctuations demonstrating the generality of the phenomenon Two-component mixture allowed for study of coupled heat and mass diffusion
measured_variables.reported: Single-component CS2 Two-component Polystyrene in Toluene

measured_variables.name: Sample Thickness
measured_variables.definition: Fluctuations in microgravity were ultimately limited by the sample thickness demonstrating their large spatial extent
measured_variables.reported: CS2 three point zero zero mm Polystyrene Toluene one mm

measured_variables.name: Temperature Gradient
measured_variables.definition: Increasing the gradient generally increased the amplitude of the fluctuations
measured_variables.reported: Varied systematically four point five to one hundred one K per cm on Earth Also done for similar ranges during flight

measured_variables.name: Measurement Technique
measured_variables.definition: Enabled measurement of small angle scattering crucial for probing long wavelength fluctuations Provided both static S of q and dynamic S of q omega information

measured_variables.name: Data Acquisition
measured_variables.definition: The static and dynamic data were taken for static and dynamic results respectively
measured_variables.reported: Static Data one frame per one hundred sec or more Dynamic Data sequence of images one hundred frames per second

measured_variables.name: Key Measured Quantities
measured_variables.definition: S of q showed dramatic enhancement and altered q dependence in microgravity S of q omega revealed changes in fluctuation dynamics in microgravity Quantitative agreement with theory within fourteen percent or better in microgravity without adjustable parameters
measured_variables.reported: Structure Factor S of q Power Spectrum S of q omega
